source: EngineArgs.add_cli_args() introspected inside eugr/spark-vllm:nightly-20260814 (repo digest sha256:ab89584706575a7af48a3d5a2a92bc48a5432781fb87925a181d8bb5eab4f5d3) on the DGX Spark.
notes: Not a tagged vLLM release. The image eugr/spark-vllm:nightly-20260814 is a nightly build from https://github.com/eugr/spark-vllm-docker at 54672f7, and its /workspace/build-metadata.yaml records upstream vllm-project/vllm main at aa3100357322995b201d5348c5490596a7bd70a9, no extra pull requests applied, built 2026-08-14 for compute capability 12.1a with torch 2.13.0, transformers 5.15.0 and FlashInfer 0.6.18 from commit 555492e. pip reports 0.27.2rc1.dev88+gaa3100357.d20260814, so the version string names the upstream commit the build was made from. The params are EngineArgs only. Server flags that the OpenAI front end adds (host, port, tool-call-parser, enable-auto-tool-choice, api-key) are not in this list, the same as the 0.26.1.dev0 entry.

params.name: aggregate-engine-logging
params.help: Log aggregate rather than per-engine statistics when using data parallelism.

params.name: async-scheduling
params.help: Overlap scheduling with the forward pass.

params.name: attention-config
params.help: API docs: https://docs.vllm.ai/en/latest/api/vllm/config/#vllm.config.AttentionConfig Should either be a valid JSON string or JSON keys passed individually.

params.name: block-size
params.help: KV cache block size in tokens.

params.name: compilation-config
params.help: API docs: https://docs.vllm.ai/en/latest/api/vllm/config/#vllm.config.CompilationConfig Should either be a valid JSON string or JSON keys passed individually.

params.name: config-format
params.help: Model config format.

params.name: cpu-offload-gb
params.help: GiB of weights to keep in CPU memory. Slow; use only when the model does not fit.

params.name: data-parallel-address
params.help: Address of data parallel cluster head-node.

params.name: data-parallel-backend
params.help: Backend for data parallel, either "mp" or "ray".

params.name: data-parallel-multi-port-external-lb
params.help: Run a node-local supervisor that launches one external-LB API server per local data parallel rank and exposes aggregated health on a supervisor port.

params.name: data-parallel-rank
params.help: Data parallel rank of this instance. When set, enables external load balancer mode for MoE data-parallel deployments. Unsupported for non-MoE models; launch independent vLLM instances instead.

params.name: data-parallel-rpc-port
params.help: Fixed port for data parallel RPC communication. All nodes must use the same port.

params.name: data-parallel-size
params.help: Number of independent replicas behind one endpoint.

params.name: data-parallel-size-local

params.name: data-parallel-start-rank

params.name: device-ids
params.help: Comma-separated physical GPU device IDs or UUIDs to use (e.g. --device-ids "2,3,5,7"). Avoids setting CUDA_VISIBLE_DEVICES, preserving full GPU topology visibility for GPU-NIC affinity and DeepGEMM. Note: has no effect with Ray executors; use Ray placement groups for GPU selection instead.

params.name: diffusion-config
params.help: API docs: https://docs.vllm.ai/en/latest/api/vllm/config/#vllm.config.DiffusionConfig Should either be a valid JSON string or JSON keys passed individually.

params.help: Fall back to NCCL for all-reduce.

params.name: disable-log-stats

params.name: disable-sliding-window
params.help: Ignore the model's sliding-window attention and use full attention.

params.name: distributed-executor-backend

params.name: dtype

params.name: ec-manager-config
params.help: API docs: https://docs.vllm.ai/en/latest/api/vllm/config/#vllm.config.EncoderCacheManagerConfig Should either be a valid JSON string or JSON keys passed individually.

params.help: API docs: https://docs.vllm.ai/en/latest/api/vllm/config/#vllm.config.ECTransferConfig Should either be a valid JSON string or JSON keys passed individually.

params.name: enable-chunked-prefill
params.help: Split long prefills across scheduler steps so decodes are not starved. Enabled by default in V1 for most models.

params.name: enable-sleep-mode

params.name: enforce-eager

params.help: Where default sampling parameters come from. Set to vllm to ignore the model's own generation_config.json.

params.name: kv-cache-dtype
params.help: KV cache element type. fp8 roughly doubles the cache at some accuracy cost.

params.name: kv-cache-memory-bytes
params.help: Parse human-readable integers like '1k', '2M', etc. Including decimal values with decimal multipliers. Examples: - '1k' -> 1,000 - '1K' -> 1,024 - '25.6k' -> 25,600

params.name: kv-events-config
params.help: API docs: https://docs.vllm.ai/en/latest/api/vllm/config/#vllm.config.KVEventsConfig Should either be a valid JSON string or JSON keys passed individually.

params.help: Should either be a valid JSON string or JSON keys passed individually.

params.name: load-format

params.name: mamba-backend
params.help: Kernel backend for Mamba/SSM layers. Verify against the exact release: this flag is newer than most of the list.

params.name: mamba-ssm-cache-dtype
params.help: Element type of the Mamba/SSM state cache for hybrid models.

params.name: max-logprobs
params.help: Maximum logprobs returned per token.

params.name: max-lora-rank
params.help: Maximum LoRA rank.

params.name: max-model-len
params.help: Parse human-readable integers like '1k', '2M', etc. Including decimal values with decimal multipliers. Also accepts -1 or 'auto' as a special value for auto-detection. Examples: - '1k' -> 1,000 - '1K' -> 1,024 - '25.6k' -> 25,600 - '-1' or 'auto' -> -1 (special value for auto-detection)

params.name: max-num-batched-tokens
params.help: Parse human-readable integers like '1k', '2M', etc. Including decimal values with decimal multipliers. Examples: - '1k' -> 1,000 - '1K' -> 1,024 - '25.6k' -> 25,600

params.name: max-num-scheduled-tokens
params.help: Parse human-readable integers like '1k', '2M', etc. Including decimal values with decimal multipliers. Examples: - '1k' -> 1,000 - '1K' -> 1,024 - '25.6k' -> 25,600

params.name: max-num-seqs
params.help: Maximum sequences in a batch.

params.name: max-parallel-loading-workers
params.help: Parallelism while loading shards; lowers peak host memory.

params.name: media-io-kwargs
params.help: Should either be a valid JSON string or JSON keys passed individually.

params.name: mm-processor-device
params.help: Device the HF multi-modal processor runs the image/video transform on. Convenience for `--mm-processor-kwargs '{"device": ...}'`: the value is resolved here and stored there, it is not kept as separate state. Only takes effect for HF "fast" (torchvision-backed) processors, which accept a `device` argument; the others ignore it and stay on CPU. "auto" uses the accelerator on encoder instances of an encode/prefill/decode deployment -- an EC producer that is not also a consumer allocates no KV cache, so its accelerator is not contended by the language model -- and then only when `--mm-tensor-ipc=torch_shm` can carry device tensors, since every other transport would copy the result back to the host and that copy costs more than it saves. "auto" resolves to "cpu" everywhere else.
